prompt: One square detailed painterly naturalistic encyclopedia illustration of Ikuchi, the immense Japanese sea-serpent yokai off Hitachi. ONE exceptionally LONG smooth dark serpentine sea creature loops over an empty old Japanese wooden boat, its snake-like head visible at left and continuous winding elongated body crossing the boat and curling away across distant water. Body has oily wet sheen and viscous dark oil drips harmlessly from it onto boat planks, clearly oil not blood; a glossy oil slick glistens on water. No limbs or wings, no horns, no dragon whiskers. Use composition with visible head and a sweeping body curve filling central frame with margins; great length recedes into sea mist rather than cropping. Ominous eerie sea menace and immense slow suffocating presence, stormy evening and realistic painted water. No sailors, attacks, blood or injury, no weapons, text or watermark. One creature, no panels.
visual_requirements: Body crosses wooden boat and leaves dark viscous oil
depicted_variant: Edo sea-serpent crossing boat and dripping oil
aura: ominous immense slow dangerous sea presence

visual_review.notes: Observed enormous extremely long limbless sea serpent with clear snake head and continuous sweeping body crossing empty wooden boat, further coils recede into sea mist. Glossy dark oil visibly drips onto planks and forms iridescent slick in water. Storm-lit looming head and immense heavy scale convey dangerous slow sea-yokai menace. No limbs/horns/wings or victims.
